autoUpdate.desc: Runs steamcmd app_update 2465200 before every start.

gameMode.desc: GameMode. Only applies to a new save; ignored when loading an existing one.

owners.desc: Comma-separated 17-digit SteamID64s written to ownerswhitelist.txt. Empty = file is left unchanged.

password.desc: Password (max 40 characters). Empty = no password. No double quotes.

skipNetTest.desc: SkipNetworkAccessibilityTest - enable if the server reports unreachable ports on startup.

install.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Download/update the Windows build of the SotF DS (app 2465200) using Linux steamcmd stored in /pufferpanel/steamcmd
set -e
export HOME=/pufferpanel
SC=/pufferpanel/steamcmd
if [ ! -x "$SC/steamcmd.sh" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] Installing steamcmd..."
  mkdir -p "$SC"
  curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$SC"
fi
"$SC/steamcmd.sh" +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /pufferpanel +login anonymous +app_update 2465200 "$@" +quit

#!/bin/bash
# One-time setup of the Wine prefix in persistent /pufferpanel/.wine
export HOME=/pufferpanel
export WINEPREFIX=/pufferpanel/.wine WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="
rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock
Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x16 -nolisten tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 &
XPID=$!
export DISPLAY=:99
sleep 2
echo "[pufferpanel] Initializing Wine prefix..."
wineboot --init
wineserver -w
echo "[pufferpanel] Installing Visual C++ 2019 runtime (winetricks vcrun2019)..."
winetricks -q vcrun2019 || echo "[pufferpanel] WARNING: failed to install vcrun2019"
wineserver -w
kill $XPID 2>/dev/null
exit 0

pre.text:
#!/bin/bash
cd /pufferpanel
export HOME=/pufferpanel
export WINEPREFIX=/pufferpanel/.wine WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="

# Virtual display for Wine
rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock
Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x16 -nolisten tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 &
export DISPLAY=:99
sleep 2

if [ ! -d "$WINEPREFIX" ]; then
  echo "[pufferpanel] Wine prefix missing, initializing..."
  wineboot --init
  wineserver -w
fi

UD=/pufferpanel/userdata
mkdir -p "$UD"

# Admins: comma-separated SteamID64s -> ownerswhitelist.txt (only when the variable is set)
if [ -n "${owners}" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "${owners}" | tr ',; ' '\n\n\n' | grep -E '^[0-9]{17}$' > "$UD/ownerswhitelist.txt"
fi

set -- -userdatapath "$UD" \
  -dedicatedserver.IpAddress 0.0.0.0 \
  -dedicatedserver.GamePort ${gamePort} \
  -dedicatedserver.QueryPort ${queryPort} \
  -dedicatedserver.BlobSyncPort ${blobSyncPort} \
  -dedicatedserver.ServerName "${serverName}" \
  -dedicatedserver.MaxPlayers ${maxPlayers} \
  -dedicatedserver.Password "${password}" \
  -dedicatedserver.GameMode ${gameMode} \
  -dedicatedserver.SaveSlot ${saveSlot} \
  -dedicatedserver.SaveInterval ${saveInterval} \
  -dedicatedserver.SkipNetworkAccessibilityTest ${skipNetTest}

# This script runs as PID 1 in the container, which ignores signals without a handler.
# Trap the stop signal, forward it to the server and fall back to killing Wine.
stop_server() {
  echo "[pufferpanel] Stopping server..."
  kill -INT "$WPID" 2>/dev/null
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    kill -0 "$WPID" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 1
  done
  if kill -0 "$WPID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[pufferpanel] Server did not exit in 30 s, killing Wine"
  fi
  wineserver -k 2>/dev/null
}
trap stop_server INT TERM

# Job control on: without it bash starts background jobs with SIGINT ignored,
# so the forwarded signal would never reach the server.
set -m
wine ./SonsOfTheForestDS.exe "$@" <&0 &
WPID=$!
wait "$WPID"
wait "$WPID" 2>/dev/null
wineserver -k 2>/dev/null
exit 0
